sections.skills: Creative writing, spoken word poetry, and narrative craft. Workshop facilitation and event planning for literary festivals and community storytelling circles. Mentorship of emerging writers. Deep domain expertise in narrative medicine, oral history, multilingual literature, and trauma-informed community engagement. Can contribute narrative architecture, user experience design, content strategy, and community-building frameworks.
sections.vision: Deeply committed to the transformative power of storytelling for social justice, healing, and cultural preservation. Driven by themes of identity, displacement, and belonging. Seeks to bridge art, humanity, and technology to amplify marginalized voices. Values radical honesty, authenticity, and intimate, contemplative collaboration.
sections.project: Current focus is on a debut novel and a forthcoming podcast project centered on the stories of immigrant communities. Interested in exploring the intersection of AI and storytelling to create interactive narrative experiences or digital platforms that preserve oral histories. Looking to prototype a digital storytelling interface or an archival system that honors oral traditions.
sections.needs: Technological guidance to translate narrative passion into viable digital or AI-integrated formats. Seeking a technical collaborator—specifically someone who can build or prototype software interfaces, mobile applications, or AI agent systems capable of processing and archiving oral/textual data.
